misprints.note: The article is printed with no breathing or accent at the top of the column. It may be a missing sort or a breathing that did not print. I kept the bare η.

uncertain.note: The omicron is broken and looks like ί, so the word reads like σκληρίς. Under magnification it is the left half of ο, so I wrote σκληρός.
The punctuation after εὐπάθεια at the line end is faint. It is either a comma or a full stop. I took it as a comma.
The breathing over epsilon is hard to read. It could be rough or smooth. I kept the rough breathing, which is the standard form.
The mark over the iota looks like an acute and not a smooth breathing. I wrote ίδος, as the book does elsewhere. The same applies to κεραμίς, ίδος in 0236_05.
